title: It was perfect, then there’s the latest update!
body:
The app was everything i dreamt of, u can record progress per task, gives u streaks stats, cute emojis, sleek and smooth look and then Boom…updated!
Now the interface is simply ugly, the progress is gone, which is a huge set back for my “all or nothing mentality” which i needed this app’s help to overcome, the stats are gone, the emojis are stiff, weird and just ugly!!
I emailed them, but got no response…so I unsubscribed…very sadly!
